description: A rough ESTIMATE of how much to set aside for income tax on the profit so far this year and this quarter, from the books and the tax authorities' published rates (Canada: federal, provincial, CPP / QPP; US: federal, state, self-employment tax), less the instalments the user recorded as paid, plus the sales tax the books hold. It lists the instalment due dates (CRA, Revenu Quebec, IRS 1040-ES, state, corporate). Not tax advice and not a return: say so when you quote it, and name the notes it gives (for example that other income is not counted).
